lines.trans: Nobody irritates cooks more than waiters.
They are unceremonious.
Hasn't my flounder grown old over there, huh?
Fedya, can you go faster?
Impatient! Girls ask me to go more slowly.
Come on, cook faster!
Careless. Worse is only a waiter who used to be a cook.
Don't touch my dish!
You have really gotten on everyone's nerves already.

examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: Чего я ждать должен свой холодец до Пасхи, а?
examples.trans: Why do I have to wait until Easter for my aspic, huh?

examples.text: Я помню свои корни.
examples.trans: I remember my roots.

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'task' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Занимайся своим делом, понял? Тогда сами переделывайте!
examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: Сделай. Давай.
examples.trans: Make it. Go on.

examples.text: Ну, что делать? Другой раз, так другой раз.
examples.trans: Well, what can we do? Another time, then another time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'understood', paired with 'понимать'.

examples.text: Занимайся своим делом, понял? Тогда сами переделывайте!
examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: Ты не умничай. Понял?
examples.trans: Don't be a smart-aleck. Got it?

examples.text: А, всё понял, не вопрос.
examples.trans: Ah, got it all, no question.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'then', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Занимайся своим делом, понял? Тогда сами переделывайте!
examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: А что тогда не идёшь? Спартак же играет!
examples.trans: Then why aren't you going? Spartak is playing!

examples.text: Подарила мне этого слона несчастного.
examples.trans: You gave me that wretched elephant.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'ourselves', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Занимайся своим делом, понял? Тогда сами переделывайте!
examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: А это как раз тот самый холодец, который я собирался вам принести.
examples.trans: And this is that very aspic that I was going to bring you.

examples.text: Я сама.
examples.trans: I'll do it myself.

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'делывать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'redo'.

examples.text: Занимайся своим делом, понял? Тогда сами переделывайте!
examples.trans: Mind your own business, got it? Then redo it yourselves!

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и переделывать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and redo on time.
